Proposals.Development: Adrian survives a catastrophic accident via experimental nanite intervention, learns the nanites have evolved within him due to interaction with the fertility drug, and explicitly commits to continued trial participation and monitoring to secure his financial survival.
Proposals.Evidence: "Okay," he said, his voice still hoarse but stronger than before. "I'll continue. I'll do the tests. Whatever you need."
Proposals.ProposedCurrentPhase: Adrian has survived the catastrophic accident through the medical nanite intervention. The nanites have interacted with the fertility drug, begun reproducing and evolving within him, and changed his physical condition. He accepts continued participation and monitoring despite his fear, completing the desperate-measure arc and setting up the investigation of his altered biology.
